official_sources.title: About Keyword Planner forecasts
official_sources.retrieval: Official search-result extraction received before a separate full-page fetch failed; limited to the text actually returned.
definitions: Average monthly searches includes the keyword and close variants, for the selected month range, location and Search Network. The default is a 12-month average, regardless of the term language.
Competition is relative advertiser participation, specific to the selected location and Search Network. It is not organic SEO difficulty or a profitability score.
Historical metrics and forecasts differ: forecasts incorporate bid, budget, seasonality and other factors; historical metrics do not.
official_sources.limit: Full-page fetch at the en URL returned HTTP 429. No retry, language-variant fetch or cached-copy workaround. The detailed historical match-type paragraph was not obtained and is not claimed as freshly verified.

official_sources.title: Refine your new keywords in Keyword Planner
definitions: Location, language, network and date are separate research controls. Removing locations sets All locations.
Google selects Google Search ideas; Google and search partners expands the network. Language selects the languages for keyword ideas; it does not prove the counted people speak only that language.
Keyword text, categories and other filters can suppress rows. Record the applied controls instead of interpreting a missing row as zero demand.

official_sources.title: Use Keyword Planner
definitions: The documented forecast path adds selected keywords to Saved keywords and creates/adds to a plan, with a selected match type; another path pastes/uploads keywords and uses Get started under Create a keyword plan.
Forecasts are refreshed daily using the last 7–10 days with seasonal adjustment. They are conditional estimates, not observed results.
The help describes forecast bid-strategy, budget and date controls; it does not establish a nonpersistent native forecast with a USD0.15 maximum-CPC control.
Very low-volume or sensitive terms may be unavailable for discovery/forecasting. Account setup including billing is documented as an access prerequisite, not an action authorized by this task.

official_sources.title: Generate Historical Metrics — Google Ads API
definitions: The historical response pairs a returned query with its close variants, average monthly searches, approximate month-level volume, competition and bid ranges.

Low/high top-of-page historical bids correspond to the 20th/80th percentiles. These are bid statistics, not this advertiser’s actual CPC, a future CPC guarantee or proof of delivery at the user ceiling.
The sample preserves absent averages, competition index and bid fields as null. Competition index is filled ad slots divided by available slots on a 0–100 scale; insufficient data can produce null.
API field nullability supports retaining missingness; this API guide does not independently establish the cause of every native UI dash or missing row.

settings_receipt: exact existing candidate ID and input text, without new variants
returned row text and whether it exactly equals input
literal displayed metric or range, with missing-state reason if UI provides one

historical_vs_match_type.interpretation: Historical keyword/close-variant demand is not literal-string-only demand, delivered search-term evidence or match-type-specific forecast traffic. Preserve the six EXACT and three PHRASE candidate identities; forecast match selection is a separate control.
historical_vs_match_type.non_additivity: Inference from close-variant inclusion: do not sum related returned rows as independent demand or manufacture separate estimates for merged/unreturned candidate spellings.

missing_metrics.normalization: Retain dash, blank, not-returned, error and explicit numeric zero as distinct raw states. Normalized unavailable numeric values remain null with status UNKNOWN_OR_NOT_REPORTED; an explicit range keeps both endpoints.
missing_metrics.limits: No row does not prove zero searches, zero competition, free clicks or availability at USD0.15. An unavailable bid or forecast cannot be replaced with the low end of a historical bid range. Do not diagnose the cause without the actual message.

nonpersistent_ceiling_forecast.current_scope: Passive native research belongs to root; no Save, plan creation, keyword addition/import, campaign creation or billing change is authorized by this documentation task.
nonpersistent_ceiling_forecast.condition_for_any_in_scope_read: Root must first observe an already accessible genuinely nonpersistent forecast surface and an explicit applicable maximum-CPC input in the correct currency. A budget-only chart or forecast average CPC of 0.15 is not proof of a 0.15 bid ceiling.
nonpersistent_ceiling_forecast.stop_boundary: If obtaining the forecast requires saving/creating a plan, Add keywords, import, campaign or billing actions, retain FORECAST_NOT_RUN_UNDER_READ_ONLY_SCOPE. Do not perform the action merely because it would not enable a live campaign.
nonpersistent_ceiling_forecast.not_a_global_impossibility_claim: This is a limit of the reviewed native workflow, not a claim that every Google API or every account UI lacks another capability.

handoff: Root records only the nine existing candidates under their actual native settings. Separate reviewer validates the root receipt. No demand, CPC, profit or launch-readiness result is produced by this method document.
